# AdminKit — Complete AI & LLM Technical Reference

> AdminKit is a production-ready Next.js admin dashboard template and component ecosystem built with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, and shadcn/ui. Designed for enterprise SaaS, CRM, e-commerce, analytics, project management, CMS, finance, and internal business applications.

---

## 1. Overview & Mission

AdminKit provides a modular, production-tested foundation for complex admin interfaces. Instead of building administrative backends from scratch, developers can leverage AdminKit's composable architecture, pre-built business domains, role-based access control, responsive layout shells, and unified design token system.

### Key Highlights
- **Framework**: Next.js 16 (App Router, Turbopack, React 19)
- **Component Architecture**: Server Components by default; Client Components used only where interactivity requires them
- **UI Library**: shadcn/ui primitives with Radix UI / Base UI foundation
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS v4 with semantic CSS custom properties
- **Typography**: Lexend font default with dynamic Google Font switching (Inter, Geist, Plus Jakarta Sans, Manrope, Outfit, DM Sans)
- **Data Tables**: TanStack Table v8 with server/client filtering, column sorting, pagination, and row selection
- **Forms & Validation**: React Hook Form with Zod schema validation
- **Internationalization (i18n)**: next-intl with localized route handlers (`/[locale]/...`) and full RTL layout support
- **State Management**: nuqs for URL search parameters; TanStack Query for client server-state; Zustand for global client-only UI state
- **Charts & Visualizations**: Recharts responsive charts
- **Rich Text Authoring**: Tiptap headless editor with markdown & HTML serialization
- **Security & RBAC**: Permission gates (`PermissionGate`), role gates (`RoleGate`), dynamic role matrix switcher, and two-factor authentication (OTP)

---

## 2. Architecture & Directory Structure

AdminKit follows domain-driven feature encapsulation and strict separation of concerns:

```text
src/
├── app/                  # Next.js App Router: thin routes, metadata, and layouts
│   └── [locale]/         # Localized routing root
│       ├── (auth)/       # Authentication routes (sign-in, sign-up, forgot-password, otp)
│       ├── (dashboard)/  # Authenticated admin routes with main layout shell
│       │   └── dashboard/
│       │       ├── apps/         # App integrations catalog
│       │       ├── chats/        # Real-time chat & messaging
│       │       ├── cms/          # Posts, pages, categories, tags
│       │       ├── ecommerce/    # Products, orders, customers, coupons, reviews, reports, settings
│       │       ├── help-center/  # Knowledge base & FAQs
│       │       ├── media/        # Media library & file manager
│       │       ├── notifications/# Notification center
│       │       ├── projects/     # Project management & milestones
│       │       ├── settings/     # Profile, account, security, billing, appearance, display
│       │       ├── tasks/        # Task management & Kanban board
│       │       └── users/        # User accounts & RBAC permissions
│       ├── (errors)/     # Error boundary pages (401, 403, 404, 500, 503)
│       ├── (marketing)/  # Public landing page & showcase
│       └── layout.tsx    # Root layout with fonts, providers, and analytics
├── components/           # Reusable UI primitives and layout infrastructure
│   ├── ui/               # shadcn/ui primitives (button, dialog, card, dropdown, etc.)
│   ├── layout/           # Sidebar, navbar, command menu, search button, profile dropdown
│   ├── shared/           # Data table components, grid pagination, badges
│   ├── media/            # Media upload dropzone, media picker dialog, file icons
│   └── rbac/             # Permission gates, role badges, roles-permission matrix
├── config/               # App configuration (site metadata, navigation, themes)
├── context/              # React context providers (theme settings, search, RBAC, notifications)
├── data/                 # Demo/mock data models and JSON seed collections
├── features/             # Business domain feature modules
│   ├── apps/             # Integrations feature logic and UI
│   ├── chats/            # Messaging threads and chat UI
│   ├── cms/              # Content editor, pages/posts columns and actions
│   ├── dashboard/        # KPI metrics, revenue charts, activity feeds
│   ├── ecommerce/        # E-commerce store management, product tables, order flows
│   ├── media/            # Media asset management feature
│   ├── notifications/    # Notifications feature
│   ├── projects/         # Projects feature
│   ├── settings/         # Settings schemas, forms, hooks, and tabs
│   ├── tasks/            # Task tracking feature
│   └── users/            # User administration feature
├── hooks/                # Reusable custom hooks (e.g., useMobile)
├── i18n/                 # next-intl configuration, routing, and request handlers
├── lib/                  # Utilities, RBAC types, helpers, icon colors
├── providers/            # Top-level client providers (ThemeProvider, TooltipProvider)
├── schemas/              # Zod validation schemas
├── styles/               # Global CSS and theme custom properties
└── types/                # Domain-independent shared TypeScript types
```

---

## 3. Engineering & Design Principles

### Layering & Data Flow
```text
Page (app/) -> Feature (features/) -> Reusable Components (components/) -> Service/Repository -> API/Database
```
- Pages are thin orchestrators responsible for routing, metadata, and passing route params.
- Feature directories contain business logic, domain-specific subcomponents, schemas, and state.
- Components in `components/` are pure, reusable presentation primitives without business logic.
- Presentation components do not make direct database or API calls.

### Server vs. Client Components Boundary
- **Server Components (Default)**: Layouts, page shells, data fetching, non-interactive presentations, and static marketing blocks.
- **Client Components (`"use client"`)**: Interactive forms, state-dependent dropdowns/dialogs, drag-and-drop zones, real-time chats, theme toggles, and command palette.
- Never mark an entire page or root layout as `"use client"` when only a child element needs interactivity.

### Design System & Semantic Tokens
AdminKit uses semantic CSS variables instead of hardcoded colors, ensuring consistent dark/light themes and custom color palettes:
- `background`, `foreground`
- `card`, `card-foreground`
- `muted`, `muted-foreground`
- `border`, `input`, `ring`
- `primary`, `secondary`, `destructive`
- `accent`, `accent-foreground`

---

## 4. Business Domain Modules

### 4.1 E-Commerce Suite (`/dashboard/ecommerce`)
- **Products**: Searchable, filterable TanStack Table with SKU, category, price, stock levels, status tags, and bulk actions.
- **Orders**: Detailed order status lifecycle (Pending, Processing, Completed, Cancelled), customer associations, and line-item breakdown.
- **Customers**: Directory tracking lifetime orders, total spend, registration date, and customer status.
- **Categories & Brands**: Categorization hierarchy with category images, slugs, and brand associations.
- **Coupons**: Percentage and fixed discount rules with expiration dates and usage quotas.
- **Reviews**: Product rating moderation queue with star ratings and sentiment review controls.
- **Reports**: Revenue charts, sales conversion breakdowns, and top-selling product metrics.
- **Settings**: Store physical address, primary currency configuration, supported payment gateways, and site visibility modes.

### 4.2 Content Management System (`/dashboard/cms`)
- **Posts & Pages**: Article and page authoring using the Tiptap rich-text editor with support for headings, bold/italic, links, quotes, and code blocks.
- **Taxonomy**: Hierarchical categories and tag assignments.
- **Publishing Status**: Draft, Published, Scheduled, and Archived states with slug generation.

### 4.3 Media Manager (`/dashboard/media`)
- **Upload Dropzone**: Multi-file drag-and-drop with progress indicators and format validation.
- **Media Picker Dialog**: Reusable modal for selecting images/files across CMS and e-commerce forms.
- **File Details Sheet**: Metadata inspection including file size, dimensions, MIME type, upload timestamp, and direct URL copy.

### 4.4 Projects & Tasks (`/dashboard/projects`, `/dashboard/tasks`)
- **Projects**: Portfolio monitoring, milestone tracking, completion percentages, and team assignment.
- **Tasks**: Kanban and list views with priority levels (Low, Medium, High, Urgent) and status workflow (Backlog, In Progress, In Review, Done).

### 4.5 User Management & RBAC (`/dashboard/users`)
- **User Directory**: User profiles, email verification badges, assigned roles, and activity status.
- **Role-Based Access Control**: Pre-configured roles (Admin, Manager, Editor, User) and granular permission gates (`projects:read`, `cms:read`, `settings:read`, etc.).
- **Role Preview Switcher**: Interactive switcher enabling developers and testers to preview the dashboard under different role permissions.

### 4.6 Communication & Notifications (`/dashboard/chats`, `/dashboard/notifications`)
- **Chat**: Split-panel conversation list, active thread view, message bubbles, timestamps, and typing state.
- **Notifications**: Popover panel in the top navigation bar plus a dedicated management page for system alerts and notifications.

### 4.7 Settings Suite (`/dashboard/settings`)
- Dedicated panels for Profile, Account, Security (password & 2FA), Billing (subscription plans & invoices), Shipping, Payments, Appearance (themes & fonts), Notifications, and Display density.

---

## 5. Available Scripts & Commands

```bash
# Start development server with Turbopack
pnpm dev

# Create optimized production build
pnpm build

# Start production server
pnpm start

# Run ESLint validation
pnpm lint
```
